questions.question: PR #1188 review, record vs its log: D36's chosen option said a failure while releasing is 'swallowed (logged)', but the record dropped '(logged)'. The form finding is that many decisions leave out the option consequences and recommendation reasons the dialogs carried (axes.md per-question items 3 and 4). How should these two fidelity gaps be handled?

options.label: Restore both from the log (Recommended)
options.description: Put '(logged)' back into D36 and copy each listed option's consequence and recommendation's reason verbatim from bcb85b21 into the record. Decision lines and IDs stay as they are. One commit, then this PR carries a record that matches its log.

options.label: Restore D36 only
options.description: Fix the dropped word now. The consequences and reasons gap goes into a follow-up backlog item, so the record stays thinner than its form requires until then.

options.label: Leave both, reply on the threads
options.description: The record stays as the session wrote it. Replies say why, and the next session reading the record cannot see why an option lost.

questions.question: Three review findings show the record adding claims that no dialog answered, and they conflict with other decisions. D35 says a stream read surfaces 'only' a listed set of categories, which leaves out D19 and D34's permission denied and not readable at s3, plus D20's cancellation. D25 extends AX-9 to E15, and its category 'changed' conflicts with D30 and D34's 'not readable'. D19's table says E14 never reaches close, while D36 says close raises a cancellation. What should happen to them?

options.label: Open items for a reopen (Recommended)
options.description: Leave the decisions' text untouched. Add one open item per conflict to the record, naming both decisions and the clause, so the spec step or a reopen decides with you. Nothing is decided outside a dialog.

options.label: Trim to what was answered
options.description: Drop D35's 'only' sentence, drop E15 from D25 and mark E14's s4 cell 'yes' in D19's table. The record then says no more than its dialogs did, which is a minimal edit of the record's own synthesis.

options.label: Decide them now in dialogs
options.description: I ask you the three questions with options and write the answers into the record as amendments to D19, D25 and D35. This decides behaviour outside an /observe session.

The one route the hook's code leaves: you type /clear in that session, which removes its arming marker, then send the fresh session there the short prompt I posted in that session's transcript. That fresh session moves the 'OP-01 PR' lines into c1c866a2, restores bcb85b21, and pushes branch op-01-stranded-logs, which I then bring into PR #1188. What do you want?

options.label: I'll /clear and send the prompt (Recommended)
options.description: The real logs land in the repo, and the trace's note is replaced by a decisions entry for c1c866a2. A worker restart before the push could re-arm the session (BK-498) and close this route, so do it soon.
